corpus: LibriSpeech train-clean-100 (CC BY 4.0), utterances not previously processed (ls_done_tc.txt excluded), transcript contains token 'a', <=10 s, shortest first
method: Project forced-alignment pipeline (wav2vec2 CTC forced alignment vs LibriSpeech human transcripts; labels never from model output). Two extraction changes vs v1/v2 mining, documented in the script: min span 0.01 s (was 0.04 — the measured cause of 'a' scarcity: a schwa aligns to 1-2 CTC frames), context pad +-0.08 s (was +-0.04).
note: The S3 headroom probes (metrics_s3.json / metrics_s3b.json) ran when 508 mined clips were on disk (588 positives incl. pool); the final 960 only strengthen the data lever, they do not change the probes' negative transfer result, which was a distribution problem, not a count problem (adult holdout AUC was already 0.93-1.00).
